clue.text: Women's organization with gift for womanless one

parts.note: WI is the Women's Institute, a British women's organisation
a dower is a gift of property, especially to a bride or widow

explanation.surface: A women's club presents a gift to a lonely man.
explanation.walkthrough: The WI (Women's Institute) is a British community organisation for women.
explanation.definitionFit: A man whose wife has died is left without a woman, hence a womanless one.

clue.text: Where there is little work at the factory

parts.note: works is a word for a factory
op is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: A place where not much gets done in the factory.
explanation.walkthrough: Worksop is a town in Nottinghamshire, England; 'Where' defines a place.
explanation.definitionFit: The clue's opening word asks for a location, and this English town is one.

clue.text: Guide-book in which parson enters jobs about the house

indicators.note: the clergyman goes into the home-improvement letters

parts.note: DIY is do-it-yourself, household jobs
a rector is a parson

explanation.surface: A guide-book on which a parson enters into house repairs.
explanation.definitionFit: A book listing names and addresses is a reference guide.

clue.text: God with a poem in his heart

definitions.text: with a poem in his heart
definitions.meaning: a cryptic description: the name has an ode at its centre

explanation.walkthrough: The second part is a description of the name's letters: W-ODE-N holds ODE in the middle.
explanation.definitionFit: The Anglo-Saxon chief deity, equivalent to Odin, whose name holds a lyric at its centre.

clue.text: The window is right so going up with a good shot

indicators.note: in a down clue the word so is read from the bottom up

parts.note: an ace is a winning shot, as in tennis

explanation.surface: The window is fine, so a good shot is going up.
explanation.definitionFit: A rose window in a church is a round ornamental window.

clue.text: Two men with a plant

parts.note: Alf is a man's name
a second Alf, as two men are named

explanation.surface: A pair of chaps stand beside a plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Lucerne, a clover-like fodder crop, is the plant in question.

clue.text: Asian bar adapted for oriental people

indicators.note: the letters of the phrase are altered into a new form

explanation.surface: An Asian bar is converted for eastern customers.
explanation.definitionFit: Natives of the Arabian peninsula are people of the East.

clue.text: Original person who makes part of the government become more exposed

parts.note: the FO is the Foreign Office, a British government department
to undress is to strip and show more skin

explanation.surface: A pioneer in a government department ends up revealing too much.
explanation.walkthrough: FO is the Foreign Office, a British government department.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman who establishes something is its originator.

clue.text: Slowly making the deity depart

parts.note: a lar is a Roman household god
to go is to depart

explanation.surface: The god takes his time over leaving.
explanation.definitionFit: As a musical direction it means play slowly and broadly.

clue.text: If a boy disappeared the lampholder would make a noise

parts.note: a lad is a boy
a din is a loud noise

explanation.surface: If the lad vanished, the lamp's owner would kick up a racket.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as a subtraction: take A LAD away from the answer and DIN, a noise, is left.
explanation.definitionFit: In the tale he owns the magic lamp with the genie.

clue.text: Red rose used to make screen

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are taken as raw material and made into something new

explanation.surface: A red rose is turned into a decorative screen.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the ornamental panel or screen behind a church altar.

clue.text: A queen comes with universal song for fishy places

parts.note: U is the film-rating abbreviation for universal
an aria is a solo song in opera

explanation.surface: A queen arrives singing a universally known song about fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Tanks for keeping fish are places full of fish, so fishy places.

clue.text: Senility comes when Robin is not the eldest

definitions.meaning: dotage, the childish state of old age

definitions.text: when Robin is not the eldest
definitions.meaning: a cryptic reading: Robin Hood as a later-born child, a younger Hood

explanation.walkthrough: The second definition splits the answer as SECOND CHILD + HOOD: Robin Hood, born second in the family, is not the eldest.
explanation.definitionFit: Dotage in old age is called a return to infancy; and a Hood born after an older sibling is a younger offspring.

clue.text: They are sent by the press but mean nothing among dons

definitions.text: They are sent by the press

indicators.note: the nought is placed amid the letters of the word for dons

parts.note: dons are university teachers, informally profs
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Printers' proofs sent out mean nothing to the university academics.
explanation.definitionFit: Printers send trial impressions of text to authors for correction.

clue.text: Paving which makes the flowers fit in

parts.note: flags are irises
colours that tone in match and fit in

explanation.surface: Paving that makes the irises blend in.
explanation.definitionFit: A flat slab of stone is used for paving.

clue.text: The inferior people started in support

parts.note: under means lower in rank, inferior

indicators.note: the start of the word people is its opening letter

explanation.surface: The lower classes began to offer their backing.
explanation.definitionFit: To prop up from beneath is to support something.

clue.text: Result of intimacy between boy and girl after planning has been started

indicators.note: the boy and girl come after the planning letter
only the start of planning is wanted, its opening letter

parts.note: Reg is a boy's name
Nancy is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A baby follows a boy and girl getting close after some planning.
explanation.definitionFit: Being with child is the outcome of sexual relations.

clue.text: The bold are not frightened so much

definitions.meaning: read as two words: dread smaller amounts

explanation.definitionFit: Brave people lack dread; and those who dread less are less frightened.

clue.text: Traveller a long way off in weary confusion

indicators.note: the distance word sits within the jumbled letters
the letters of weary are thrown into disorder

parts.note: far means a long way off

explanation.surface: A traveller, far from home, is weary and confused.
explanation.walkthrough: 'confusion' mixes WEARY into WAYER, and 'in' places FAR inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who goes on a journey on foot is a traveller.

clue.text: Changing leaderless part of London

indicators.note: the word loses its first letter, its leader

parts.note: swapping means changing

explanation.surface: A London district without a leader is changing.
explanation.walkthrough: Wapping is a district of East London by the Thames.
explanation.definitionFit: A district in east London by the Thames docks.

clue.text: Claim an advantage when holding a king

indicators.note: the word for advantage grips the king's letter in its middle

parts.note: an asset is an advantage
R is short for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: Someone stakes a claim to a benefit by holding a king in a card game.
explanation.definitionFit: To state something firmly is to claim it.

clue.text: Samplers with flowers behind' head of table

indicators.note: the flowers come behind the table's first letter
the top of table is its first letter

parts.note: asters are daisy-like flowers

explanation.surface: Samplers with flowers set behind the head of the table.
explanation.definitionFit: People who try food or wine are samplers.

clue.text: Self-centredness exists for example in one who has received a high honour

parts.note: e.g. means for example

indicators.note: the verb meaning exists goes inside the honour

parts.words: one who has received a high honour
parts.note: OM is the Order of Merit, a high British honour
is means exists

explanation.surface: Self-importance exists, for example, in a distinguished honoree.
explanation.walkthrough: OM is the Order of Merit, a high British honour.
explanation.definitionFit: Selfishness or a focus on oneself is self-centredness.

clue.text: Lawsuits are without a firm basis but they provide means of enjoyment

parts.note: a plea is a suit or action at law
sure grounds are a firm basis for something

explanation.surface: Legal actions are unfounded, though they offer some pleasure.
explanation.walkthrough: PLEA plus SURE GROUNDS; the plural 'Lawsuits' shares its S with SURE, and 'are without a' is linking padding in this old puzzle.
explanation.definitionFit: Parks and gardens laid out for recreation give people enjoyment.

clue.text: Get rid of fish at about tenpence

indicators.note: the fish is placed around the money

parts.note: an eel is a fish
X is the Roman ten and P is pence

explanation.surface: Throw out the fish at about ten pence.
explanation.definitionFit: To expel is to drive out or get rid of.

clue.text: Shell which goes right over me when there is an alternative about

indicators.note: the right letter goes past the end of me

parts.note: or introduces an alternative

explanation.surface: A shell that goes right over me when an alternative turns up.
explanation.walkthrough: An ormer is an abalone, a shellfish of the Channel Islands.
explanation.definitionFit: An abalone is an edible shellfish, here called a shell.

clue.text: Get better and so make the devil wander off

parts.note: an imp is a little devil
to rove is to wander

explanation.surface: Get well and send the little devil away.
explanation.definitionFit: To make progress or recover is to get better.

clue.text: That is including writing about people being huge

indicators.note: the abbreviation for that is takes in the rest

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation for id est, that is

indicators.note: the writing abbreviation goes round the people

parts.note: MS is short for manuscript, a piece of writing
men means people

explanation.surface: That is, writing about people on a vast scale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts MS round MEN for MMENS, and 'including' sets that inside IE.
explanation.definitionFit: Something vast or enormous is huge.

clue.text: More than one printer's craft

definitions.meaning: a printer's galley is the tray holding set type; this asks for the plural

explanation.definitionFit: Printers' type trays and oared warships share the name.

clue.text: God is about to try reforming the self-sacrificing

indicators.note: the god's name goes around the rearranged letters

parts.note: Mars is the Roman god of war

indicators.note: the letters of try are formed again in a new order

explanation.surface: A god is about to make the selfless try again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reforming' turns TRY into TYR, and 'about' places MARS around it.
explanation.definitionFit: People who give up their lives for a cause are self-sacrificing.
